Then I shall charge onward! To do battle with destiny! No, wait, but my master did say that to wish for too much at once is the same as losing it all. Does that mean I must stay true to only one!? Ohhh! What am I to do! And to choose between Ymir-san and Kasumi... Ngh, this is all the fault of those Ze=Ode scum... If not for them, I would never have had to taste such agonyyyy... Hah! So does that mean that, to turn their plan against them, I must protect my love for both of them and my loyalty to the Princess, all at once? No, but then I would defy my master's teaching. Aaaaah, what am I supposed to dooooo!!
